title: D-087 CAD-1: zero-dependency DXF writer core - layered site plan (lot, building outline, 3DFACE massing walls, annotation) AutoCAD opens directly (module + tests; no route, no UI)
objective: Build services/api/app/cad/dxf_writer.py: a deterministic, dependency-free ASCII DXF writer AutoCAD opens natively (the D-087-R004 'middleman' working reading): HEADER ($ACADVER + the drawing-units variable + extents), TABLES (LTYPE + LAYER with named layers and colors), ENTITIES (LINE, closed 2D polyline, TEXT, 3DFACE), EOF - choosing the most widely openable DXF version and citing the Autodesk DXF Reference for every structural choice. A typed document model with strict validation, fail-closed typed errors, and a pure site-plan builder: lot ring + building outline ring + floor stack -> layers LOT, BUILDING_OUTLINE, MASSING_3D (3DFACE wall quads per floor band + outline polylines at each elevation), ANNOTATION (the proposed-not-a-city-record label, CRS/units note, generator version). Coordinates are EPSG:2263 US survey feet (world) with the unit declared in the header.
business_reason: The owner asked for buildings that import into AutoCAD (D-087-R004/R006); an open DXF export is the licence-free path AutoCAD opens directly and saves as DWG, while native DWG stays an owner licensing decision (R007).

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (structure): output is ASCII with strictly alternating group-code/value lines, sections in the reference order, terminated by 0/EOF; an in-test minimal group-code reader parses it back; identical inputs give byte-identical output (golden sha256).

AS-2 (site plan content): a fixture lot + an L-shaped building + 3 floors yields exactly the layers LOT, BUILDING_OUTLINE, MASSING_3D, ANNOTATION; closed outlines; 3DFACE count = wall edges x floor bands; every written coordinate equals its input (round-trip) and the header declares the drawing unit.

AS-3 (fail-closed + injection): non-finite coordinates, open/degenerate rings, invalid layer names, and over-cap entity counts each give a typed refusal with no partial output; a text value containing CR/LF cannot break the stream - mutation: bypassing the sanitizer reddens a named test.
AS-4 (honesty): the ANNOTATION layer always carries 'PROPOSED - NOT A CITY RECORD' plus the CRS/units note; no claim-class words appear in any emitted string (grep in the test).
AS-5 (scope): zero new dependencies; ruff clean; modularity exit 0; exactly the allowed_paths change; no route or web change.
